verses.text: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
lines: Listen to my prayer, God.
Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

verses.text: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
lines: Attend to me, and answer me.
I am restless in my complaint,
and moan

verses.text: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
lines: because of the voice of the enemy,
because of the oppression of the wicked.
For they bring suffering on me.
In anger they hold a grudge against me.

verses.text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
lines: My heart is severely pained within me.
The terrors of death have fallen on me.

verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
lines: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me.
Horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.text: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
lines: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove!
Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

verses.text: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.”
lines: Behold, then I would wander far off.
I would lodge in the wilderness.”

verses.text: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
lines: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

verses.text: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
lines: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language,
for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.text: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
lines: Day and night they prowl around on its walls.
Malice and abuse are also within her.

verses.text: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
lines: Destructive forces are within her.
Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

verses.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
lines: For it was not an enemy who insulted me,
then I could have endured it.
Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me,
then I would have hidden myself from him.

verses.text: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
lines: But it was you, a man like me,
my companion, and my familiar friend.

verses.text: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
lines: We took sweet fellowship together.
We walked in God’s house with company.

verses.text: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
lines: Let death come suddenly on them.
Let them go down alive into Sheol.
For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

verses.text: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
lines: As for me, I will call on God.
Yahweh will save me.

verses.text: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
lines: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress.
He will hear my voice.

verses.text: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
lines: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me,
although there are many who oppose me.

verses.text: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. They never change, who don’t fear God.
lines: God, who is enthroned forever,
will hear and answer them.
They never change,
who don’t fear God.

verses.text: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
lines: He raises his hands against his friends.
He has violated his covenant.

verses.text: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
lines: His mouth was smooth as butter,
but his heart was war.
His words were softer than oil,
yet they were drawn swords.

verses.text: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
lines: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you.
He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

verses.text: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
lines: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction.
Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days,
but I will trust in you.
